clippings.speaker: Johnny Depp
clippings.quote: I feel a very strong connection to Tim and I trust him completely. Because for an actor, it's amazing to be invited into his world and to be given the responsibility of being on the ride to deliver his vision.
clippings.title: Burton and Depp: Wide awake in 'Sleepy Hollow'
clippings.context: Depp, interviewed by CNN's Donna Freydkin in New York, on why he agreed to a third film with Burton.

clippings.speaker: Johnny Depp
clippings.quote: There was an instant connection. It was a kind of understanding, a non-understanding, an appreciation for life and human behavior, for what is considered normal and what is not considered normal.
clippings.title: Brooding Johnny muses on his motley career and reinventing Ichabod Crane for Tim Burton's 'Sleepy Hollow'
clippings.context: Depp, asked how he and Burton ended up on the same wavelength, describing their first meeting, in a San Francisco interview.

clippings.speaker: Johnny Depp
clippings.quote: I was TV boy. No director in his right mind would hire me to play this character.
clippings.title: Burton on Burton (introduction by Johnny Depp)
clippings.context: Depp's introduction to the Burton book, describing how unlikely he seemed for Edward Scissorhands; Salon quotes it in a 1999 profile.

clippings.speaker: Tim Burton
clippings.quote: I connected with him when I met him for Edward Scissorhands: He was similar to me, kind of suburban white trash. It was not even a verbal understanding… It was something I could feel.
clippings.title: Tim Burton Shares Why Johnny Depp Became a Frequent Collaborator of His
clippings.context: Burton, at a masterclass at the Lumière Film Festival, asked about his work with Depp.

clippings.speaker: Tim Burton
clippings.quote: He gets me and he is passionate about a lot of the same ideas I am.
clippings.title: Our Tim Burton Interview (by Lizzy)
clippings.context: Burton, in a fan-site interview, asked about the value of working with the same actors again.

clippings.speaker: Tim Burton
clippings.quote: There’s a sadness about Johnny I just respond to — and I find it kind of funny.
clippings.title: Johnny Deppth
clippings.context: Burton remark, undated, quoted by Michael Sragow in a 1999 Salon profile of Depp before Sleepy Hollow; the article says only that Burton once said it.

notes: Depp Zone archive pages (Playboy 1996, Burton on Burton, Combustible Celluloid 1999) and Far Out quotes were skipped: archive is http-only with a cert mismatch, and Far Out is secondary. Variety, Deadline, IndieWire, Forbes were paywalled, blocked or redirected; Newsweek and CBS quotes were not verified verbatim. Direction split: 3 Depp, 3 Burton.
